Allow mints without a signing key

Some mints publish no signing key. Your wallet then can\'t check that their notes are real, nor notice if such a mint is swapped. Off: a note from one is received into your home mint over Lightning, after you agree to its fee. On: such mints can be added and hold your money. For this wallet only.
